title: Shop voice order status callback result
description: Structured result of the owner callback after a vendor order call. No payment is transferred as part of this call.

status_callback_completed.description: True when the status update was delivered to the owner.

order_id.description: Ledger order this callback reports on.

status_reported.description: Matches the order status categories used elsewhere in the ledger.

eta_text.description: Delivery estimate relayed to the owner, if any.

amount_confirmed.description: Only set if a quoted amount was read back and confirmed.
